name: @fromcode119/archor
description: Architecture boundary enforcement — who may import what, which layer may call which, and the shape a plugin/theme/appearance must keep. Standalone like reactor/nextor/typor; Node-only build tooling, never imported by application code.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild src/cli/archor-cli.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --outfile=dist/archor-cli.cjs
